text.value: I opened a restaurant in 1986 and I have owned a business ever since. I was always the one who picked the tools, connected them and made them work. Big companies have a name for that job. A CTO is a Chief Technology Officer, the person who decides which tools a company runs on and makes all of them work together. I did that job in every business I owned, for forty years. That is the half of the business most people with an audience never had anybody bring them. You bring what you know. My team and I bring everything that sells it.

text.label: Text: Good help was hard to find and harder to
text.value: Good help was hard to find and harder to keep, so in the first four I did it all myself: the work, the books, the follow-up, the ads, and yes, I was the computer guy too. Every time a better tool showed up, I was the one who learned it, set it up and made it earn its keep.

text.label: Text: So I have sat in your chair. I know what
text.value: So I have sat in your chair. I know what it feels like to be great at the work and still buried under every message, every sale and every follow-up. I have lived it four times. Steven James Consulting does not run that way. It has a team behind the work, and the systems that finally make a team worth having. That is the difference between then and now, and it is why I can say this plainly: I package your knowledge and build it all for you.

text.value: This job could not exist before. If you had something worth hearing, you needed radio or television to be heard. That is how this company runs, and it is what my team and I build for you.

text.value: Mortgages taught me speed and follow-up. The person asking a question today is interested today. Wait until tomorrow and they have moved on or found somebody else. props.text: Out of forty years and five businesses, this is the part I like best. Tying the systems together. Connecting the dots so what you teach runs as one machine instead of six disconnected ones.

Most people who built an audience find this side of it boring: the tracking and the numbers. I have never found it boring. For you there are four that matter. How many people came to your website, how many asked a question, how many booked a call and how many paid you. If you cannot see those four, you do not know what is going on inside what you have built. You are guessing.
So when someone tells me they want their systems connected and their numbers tracked, that is a good day for me. Those are my favorite people to work with.

You do not have to love the numbers the way I do. You do have to look at them. Four numbers, a short look, and you know where your next dollar is coming from. The deeper ones, like what a buyer cost to win, which video or system brought them in, and what that buyer is worth to you over time, my team and I track for you and show you in plain words. That is the difference between running this as a business and hoping it works out.
I say that plainly because it is what I believe, and because it is the whole reason this company exists. If you cannot see your own numbers, you cannot improve anything I build for you.

text.label: Text: Our part.
text.value: Our part.

text.value: My team and I do the building. We write and build the website. We turn what you know into your e-book. We set up and produce your podcast, cut each recording into clips and put them out on every platform. We train your AI employees and connect the six systems so they work as one. Then we keep it running and keep making it better.

text.label: Text: Your week, once it runs.
text.value: Your week, once it runs.

text.label: Text: It is those same four things. You record. You take the calls
text.value: It is those same four things. You record. You take the calls that come in, with people who have seen you several times and asked to talk. You take care of the clients you already have. You look at four numbers that show who came, who asked, who booked and who paid. The messages that used to land on your phone at all hours get answered by your AI employees, and the follow-up happens whether or not anybody remembers. You get back to doing the thing that built your audience in the first place.

text.label: Text: Why only a few.
text.value: Why only a few.

text.label: Text: We work with 5 to 10 clients at a time, and that is on purpo
text.value: We work with 5 to 10 clients at a time, and that is on purpose. A talent agency that takes on everybody is not really behind anybody. Every one of these is built around one person, that person's knowledge and that person's audience. Your book is not like the last client's book. Your AI employees are trained on your programs and nobody else's. That kind of work takes attention, and I would rather get behind a few people properly than a lot of them halfway. It also takes you. If having your own podcast and your own product scares you, we are not the right fit.

text.label: Text: It keeps getting better.
text.value: It keeps getting better.

text.label: Text: We stay after it is built. My team and I watch the numbers w
text.value: We stay after it is built. My team and I watch the numbers with you, find the step where people are dropping off, and fix that step. When you add a program, change a price or write a second book, your AI employees get trained on it. When something is earning well, I will show you the number and we put more behind it. That is how what you know keeps earning more.

text.value: You get the team for the work and you get me for the thinking.
